name: Cascading Lightning Bolt Trap (CR 6)
body:
XP 2,400

Type magical; Perception DC 28; Disable Device DC 28

EFFECTS

Trigger proximity (passing through the threshold); Reset no

Effect spell effect (three lightning bolts one after another in the same round, 6d6 damage each, Reflex DC 15 half each)
